info.name: Event Planner - Weather Service Testing
info.description:
Comprehensive testing collection for the Event Planner Weather Service through the API Gateway. This collection includes all weather forecasting endpoints, location-based weather data, and weather alerts functionality.

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Set the base URL environment variable (see below)
3. Follow the testing sequence in order

## Environment Variables:
- `base_url`: http://localhost:8080 (API Gateway URL)
- `auth_token`: JWT token from Auth Service (set after login)
- `weather_alert_id`: Will be set automatically after creating a weather alert
- `event_id`: Event ID for testing (set manually or from Event Service)

## Testing Sequence:
1. Start with Health Check
2. Test Swagger UI access
3. Test OpenAPI documentation
4. Test direct access (should fail)
5. Test X-Internal-Auth mechanism
